art_note: The mockups appear composited and lack true luxury campaign standards.
desc_en: This stand collar sweatshirt combines structured design with a relaxed silhouette. Crafted from soft polyester fabric, it features long sleeves and a refined button closure at the neck. Ideal for transitional seasons, it delivers exceptional comfort without sacrificing elegance. Each piece is made to order and available with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Esta sudadera de cuello alto combina un diseño estructurado con una silueta relajada. Confeccionada en suave tejido de poliéster, presenta mangas largas y un refinado cierre de botones en el cuello. Ideal para las temporadas de transición, ofrece una comodidad excepcional sin sacrificar la elegancia. Cada pieza se elabora bajo pedido y cuenta con envío a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· Made from polyester fabric
· Stand collar design with button closure
· Long sleeves and pullover silhouette
· Hand and machine washable
· Made to order with worldwide shipping
details_es:
